description: This file contains shell functions and scripts to configure and manage DHCPv6 client protocol behavior on a Linux-based networking device. It includes configuration initialization, setup, renewal, and teardown functions, as well as helper functions for handling DHCPv6 options and prefixes.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_init_config
methods.description: Initializes DHCPv6 protocol configuration parameters with various options such as request address, prefix, client ID, options, and other DHCPv6 settings.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_prefix
methods.description: Appends a prefix to an existing list of prefixes.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_add_sendopts
methods.description: Adds DHCPv6 send options to the configuration.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_setup
methods.description: Sets up and starts the DHCPv6 client with configuration parameters and invokes the DHCPv6 client daemon.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_renew
methods.description: Sends a signal to renew the DHCPv6 lease for the given interface.

methods.name: proto_dhcpv6_teardown
methods.description: Terminates DHCPv6 client process for the given interface.
